title: Decide whether a TensorFlow candidate may receive traffic
description: Choose a change, collect its required evidence, set the rollout boundary, and inject a serving failure to test promotion and rollback decisions.

changes.label: Custom layer change
changes.detail: Alter variables, training behavior, or serialization in a subclassed layer.

changes.label: TensorFlow or Keras upgrade
changes.detail: Move the runtime while keeping the same model and serving contract.

changes.label: Input signature change
changes.detail: Change tensor shape, dtype, feature name, or preprocessing behavior.

topologies.label: Isolated candidate pool
topologies.detail: The candidate has separate workers, queue, and artifact version.

topologies.label: In-place shared pool
topologies.detail: Candidate and reference versions share capacity and replacement order.

gates.label: Clean artifact reload
gates.detail: Load the exported artifact in a clean serving image without training code.

gates.label: Signature and schema contract
gates.detail: Verify names, dtypes, ranks, dimensions, output keys, and invalid-input behavior.

gates.label: Eager and graph parity
gates.detail: Compare bounded numerical outputs and state updates across execution modes.

gates.label: Evaluation slice floors
gates.detail: Meet aggregate and critical-slice quality, calibration, and safety thresholds.

gates.label: Serving load envelope
gates.detail: Meet latency, throughput, error, memory, and warmup targets under representative load.

gates.label: Candidate telemetry
gates.detail: Confirm version labels, request metrics, saturation signals, and alert routing.

gates.label: Migration rehearsal
gates.detail: Exercise checkpoint, custom-object, preprocessing, and runtime compatibility paths.

gates.label: Warm rollback
gates.detail: Keep a known-good version loaded and prove traffic can return within the budget.

failures.label: No failure
failures.detail: Evaluate the planned release with healthy candidate workers.
failures.signal: Candidate signals remain inside their release thresholds.

failures.label: Signature mismatch
failures.detail: A client sends a required feature name that the candidate no longer accepts.
failures.signal: Invalid-argument errors rise only on the candidate version.
failures.containment: Stop candidate routing and restore the previous signature contract.

failures.label: Tail-latency regression
failures.detail: The candidate passes correctness checks but exceeds its p99 latency gate.
failures.signal: Queue time and p99 latency rise while reference capacity remains healthy.
failures.containment: Abort promotion before retries and queue growth consume shared capacity.

failures.label: Worker out of memory
failures.detail: A candidate loads successfully, then exhausts memory under production-shaped batches.
failures.signal: Candidate restarts and unavailable-version errors increase together.
failures.containment: Remove the failed candidate pool and retain the loaded reference version.
